method: Manual CUA browser interaction and DOM/screenshot inspection against the local application
checks: Desktop 1280x720: critical readings, controls, model, waveform and health review visible without horizontal overflow
Mobile 390x844: document client and scroll width both 375px; navigation, reading grid, controls and model stack without horizontal overflow
Temporary mobile viewport reset to the default desktop viewport
Review this run retained the exact simulation ID and selected the simulation maintenance tab despite a previously selected imported recording
Evidence view showed fresh protocol/report/source binding match, 6/87 earlier warnings, 81 ties, 2 nuisance episodes and the 35.04C hot-spot P95 error
Rehearsal view displayed the same five-step one-run sequence as the dossier
New labelled simulation created successfully through the browser; previous run retained
Apply 30% reduction changed load from 110% to 77% and phase RMS current from 924.03A to 646.82A immediately
At the intervention instant hot-spot remained 79C; after five simulated minutes it was 81C with oil 66.4C, demonstrating thermal state continuity rather than instant recovery
Declared degraded-cooling warning remained after load reduction; no physical repair was claimed
Zero additional reduction state displayed one unchanged-input trajectory and no apply button
Captured browser error log contained no errors at the end of the reviewed flows
limitations: This is a local browser rehearsal of selected flows, not an exhaustive browser/device matrix or cloud soak test
Simulation actions do not establish physical accuracy or successful commissioning
Screenshot states contain generated simulation readings, not physical measurements
